Я помогу подобрать оптимальный комплект диспенсеров и расходных материалов Tork (Essity), примерить их на фото вашего санузла и рассчитать точную стоимость.

Шаг 1 из 2. Выберите тип вашего объекта:
Вы использовали дневной лимит визуализаций (5 в сутки). Наш менеджер в Казахстане свяжется с вами для индивидуального расчета и бесплатного тест-драйва оборудования.

parameters.query:
WITH client_context AS (
    SELECT 
        '{{ (() => { try { return JSON.parse($("Call VLM (OpenAI-Compatible)").item.json.choices[0].message.content).recommended_color || "white"; } catch(e) { return "white"; } })() }}'::VARCHAR AS target_color,
        '{{ $("Upsert User Session").item.json.business_segment || "HoReCa" }}'::VARCHAR AS target_segment,
        {{ $("Upsert User Session").item.json.distributor_id || 1 }}::INT AS target_distributor_id
),
scored_dispensers AS (
    SELECT 
        v.*,
        (
            CASE WHEN (SELECT target_segment FROM client_context) = ANY(v.segment_fit) THEN 50 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN v.is_focus_item = TRUE THEN 40 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN v.is_promo = TRUE THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS match_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.product_type 
            ORDER BY 
                (
                    CASE WHEN (SELECT target_segment FROM client_context) = ANY(v.segment_fit) THEN 50 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN v.is_focus_item = TRUE THEN 40 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN v.is_promo = TRUE THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                v.priority_rank ASC,
                v.sku ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM v_products_active v, client_context ctx
    WHERE v.category = 'dispenser'
      AND v.product_type IN ('hand_towel', 'soap')
      AND (
          v.color = ctx.target_color
          OR (
              NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM v_products_active v2 
                  WHERE v2.category = 'dispenser' 
                    AND v2.product_type = v.product_type 
                    AND v2.color = ctx.target_color
              ) AND v.color = 'white'
          )
      )
),
selected_dispensers AS (
    SELECT * FROM scored_dispensers WHERE rn = 1
),
scored_refills AS (
    SELECT 
        v.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.system_code 
            ORDER BY 
                v.priority_rank ASC,
                v.is_focus_item DESC,
                (CASE WHEN (SELECT target_segment FROM client_context) = ANY(v.segment_fit) THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                v.sku ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM v_products_active v
    WHERE v.category = 'refill'
      AND v.system_code IN (SELECT system_code FROM selected_dispensers)
),
selected_refills AS (
    SELECT * FROM scored_refills WHERE rn = 1
),
combined_items AS (
    SELECT 
        sku, name, category, product_type, system_code, design_line, 
        color, traffic_level, dimensions_cm, refill_norms, 
        image_url, is_focus_item, price_eur, priority_rank, 
        margin_tier, segment_fit, is_promo, current_price_kzt,
        1 AS sort_order
    FROM selected_dispensers
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        sku, name, category, product_type, system_code, design_line, 
        color, traffic_level, dimensions_cm, refill_norms, 
        image_url, is_focus_item, price_eur, priority_rank, 
        margin_tier, segment_fit, is_promo, current_price_kzt,
        2 AS sort_order
    FROM selected_refills
)
SELECT 
    ci.*,
    ci.current_price_kzt AS price,
    d.currency,
    d.name as distributor_name,
    d.bin as distributor_bin,
    d.city as distributor_city,
    d.address as distributor_address,
    d.contact_phone as distributor_phone,
    d.contact_email as distributor_email
FROM combined_items ci
CROSS JOIN distributors d
WHERE d.id = (SELECT target_distributor_id FROM client_context)
ORDER BY ci.sort_order, ci.product_type, ci.sku;
